value.rationale: The star is a canonical hub-dominated quantum-transport geometry. Previous qualitative dephasing-induced slowing motivates a precise full-spectrum optimum. A complete all-size spectral factorization and unique optimizer reveal a nontrivial crossover with optimal gamma growing as sqrt(degree) but maximum gap shrinking as inverse sqrt(degree), plus an exceptional two-leaf threshold. The exact parameter law is a natural and reusable asymptotic noise-design invariant, not an arbitrarily selected finite case. The result makes no claims about finite-time or initial-state-dependent metrics.
